name: Special City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m. AMENDED 1-8-24
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m. AMENDED 1-8-24
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 10, 2024 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL - Council Member Ehlers will be participating via teleconference from Calle Principal Hotel Barceló 1, Room #6217, Punta Cana 23001, Dominican Republic
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
Design and Plans for Safety Enhancement Projects for Bicycle Facilities. Environmental Considerations: It has been determined that the proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301(c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. Maintenance, striping, and repair are proposed on an existing public street and does not create additional automobile lanes. The proposed project meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1) Approve the plans for safety enhancement projects for bicycle facilities; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-05, titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Approving the Design and Plans for Safety Enhancement Projects for Bicycle Facilities, Pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6."
2024-01-10 Special Meeting Item 01 Bike Emergency Projects
2024-01-10 Special Meeting Item 01 Bike Emergency Projects - Public Comment
2024-01-10 Special Meeting Item 01 Bike Emergency Projects - Staff Presentation
2.
Design and Plans for the Safety and Mobility Enhancement Project on Saxony Road and Quail Gardens Drive. Environmental Considerations: It has been determined that the proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301(c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. Maintenance, striping, and repair are proposed on existing public streets and do not create additional automobile lanes. The proposed project meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1) Approve the plans for the Safety and Mobility Enhancement Project on Saxony Road and Quail Gardens Drive; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-04, titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Approving the Design and Plans for Safety and Mobility Enhancement Projects on Saxony Road and Quail Gardens Drive Pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6."

2024-01-10 Special Meeting Item 02 Saxony & QGD Mobility Imp - Staff Presentation
3.
Designation of the intersection control at La Costa Avenue and Sheridan Road as All-Way Stop Control (AWSC). Environmental Considerations: The proposed action is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301(c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Adopt Resolution No. 2024-06 titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Establishing All-Way Stop Control at the Intersection of La Costa Avenue and Sheridan Road."
2024-01-10 Special Meeting Item 03 AWSC at La Costa & Sheridan
2024-01-10 Special Meeting Item 03 AWSC at La Costa & Sheridan - Public Comment
2024-01-10 Special Meeting Item 03 AWSC at La Costa & Sheridan - Staff Presentation
4.
Consideration of the Draft Encinitas Traffic Management Program (ETMP). Environmental Considerations: This project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of the CEQA Guidelines. The action being considered by the City Council is an administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Approve the Draft Encinitas Traffic Management Program, to replace the old Encinitas Neighborhood Management Program (ENTMP).

ADJOURNMENT
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
